questions.question: Can genuine RPT artifacts be acquired and passively inventoried?
questions.observation: Three publicly downloadable .rpt artifacts are CFB v3. Directory paths, kinds and lengths match independent Python olefile 0.47. No stream semantics are inferred.

questions.question: Can this host execute an SAP-supported extraction/render oracle?
questions.observation: java, dotnet, wine and pwsh absent from PATH. No SAP/Crystal/BusinessObjects-named directories in /opt or /usr/share/java. This bounded search does not prove no remote installation exists. No configured SAP endpoint was provided.

questions.question: Does SAP document a supported semantic extraction route?
questions.observation: ReportClientDocument exposes ReportDefController, DataDefController and SubreportController; PrintOutputController exports reference output. Enterprise deployments use IReportAppFactory. APIs and deployment prerequisites must be exercised against an available supported installation.

questions.question: Have formulas, grouping, subreport links, pagination and original rendered outputs been reproduced?
questions.observation: No SAP runtime output obtained. Directory names and saved stream presence do not establish formula or layout semantics.

provenance.authorDescription: Repository describes Crystal Reports coursework using Xtreme sample data. Runtime authenticity was not independently confirmed with SAP.
provenance.redistribution: No downloaded report binaries or database content committed; only directory metadata and hashes.

implementation.supported: CFB v3/v4 directory inventory with header-resident DIFAT; bounded bytes, directory sectors, nesting and graph traversal.
notSupported: Decoding stream content or validating stream allocation chains
implementation.candidateDetection: Observed ReportInfo and QESession stream names are heuristic; never authenticates Crystal format or executable compatibility.

rea.diagnostic: Codex registration aligned; no REA tools connected in session; no native engine installed. Registration was not changed.
rea.evidenceType: ordinary shell CFB inspection and independent olefile output; not REA Evidence or runtime observation

nextSteps: Provide a supported Crystal Reports .NET installation or SAP RAS service and known data source for the downloaded samples.
Run a narrow exporter using supported ReportClientDocument controllers and retain SDK version, original RPT SHA, complete field/formula/group/subreport definitions, and reference PDF output.
Add explicit formula dialect/version and unsupported-construct reporting; preserve original expressions without pretending translation occurred.
Implement one executable report subset and compare numeric values, null/date/locale behavior, grouping/order, page breaks and nested subreports against SAP outputs.
Keep the full Crystal migration release gate blocked until supported features have executable source-vs-target acceptance evidence.
